text:
ella: FYI us-west1 pool-3 p90 spike at ~12:03 UTC, ops-bot alerted. suspect noisy tenant pbd-mlprep. anyone free to triage?
jon: dashboards show p99 jump 2.4s -> 6.8s for gen calls. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/board/allocs?panel=latency
priya: can we carve them out to a short dedicated slice or shift to preemptible? what's 8h cost delta?
mike: quick mitigation: lower soft_affinity for pool-3 and set a fallback to a temp dedicated pool with ttl 8h. sample: route default pools [pool-3,pool-dedicated-fallback] soft_affinity 0.55 fallback.pool pool-dedicated-fallback ttl 8h
ella: host logs show NIC tx queues and NVMe wait bumps, points to I/O heavy job not pure GPU hog: [12:03:10] host-rack18 nic_tx_full=1242 txq_len=4096 [12:03:12] nvme_io_wait_ms=85 io_ops=4321 [12:03:15] alloc=pool-3 tenant=pbd-mlprep kvcache_misses=0.62
jon: run tenant-fingerprint: ./tools/tenant-fingerprint --tenant pbd-mlprep --since 6h to get request size hist and egress.
priya: cost quick calc: 8h dedicated (2x A100 equiv) ~ $420 incremental, but predicted p99 improvement to ~2.5s for neighbors.
mike: I'll canary the routing change at 10% in ~5m, then ramp. also will cap tenant egress to 50mbit to reduce NVMe tail.
ops-bot: incident INC-20250216-0091 created, sev=sev2, assignees @ella @mike
ella: action items: mike apply canary + egress cap; jon capture kvcache hit rate & RT hist for pool-3; priya prepare cost note for sales. coordinating with support.
jon: pulling traces now, will report histograms.
priya: prepping 1-pager for sales.
mike: running canary: rctl patch route default --soft_affinity 0.55 --canary 10% --note "noisy-tenant mitigation". monitoring 15m.
jon: initial canary data: shared tenants p99 ~3.0s down from 6.8s in first 3m.
ella: good progress. keep monitoring; avoid full dedicated carve unless required. will close when stable or escalate for carve + postmortem if it repeats.
